ops.title: Ensure Python-Rust parity across new structured fields and enum expansions
ops.description: Every model change in the structured-signals migration lands with its Rust port (types.rs/parse.rs/event.rs lockstep — positional call1 misassigns silently), parity fixtures with distinctive per-field values, and literal re-pins where filterspec/mining constants change. Rebuild the extension before interpreting any parity failure.

ops.text: All parity suites (backend, mining, activity, filter, toolchain, literals) green after each phase commit
Every new field has a parity fixture with a distinctive value guarding against positional call1 misassignment
Differential corpus run: checkout with vs without CC_TRANSCRIPT_DISABLE_RUST=1 diffs to zero
